newsitem.title: USA: Truck plows into California restaurant, 12 hurt.
newsitem.headline: Truck plows into California restaurant, 12 hurt.

text.p: A pickup truck ploughed into a crowded restaurant in Pinole, Calif., injuring up to 12 people, some seriously, police said early Sunday.
The truck slammed into a Long John Silver restaurant in the city of Pinole, 15 miles northeast of San Francisco, at about 7:40 p.m. PST (10:40 p.m. EST) Saturday.
The truck broke through the restaurant's outer wall, hitting tables inside, Pinole police Sgt. Danny Hughes said.
No one was killed, but police said about a dozen people were injured, including two young children and the woman who was driving the truck.
"It was very chaotic at first," Hughes said. "There was a lot of debris scattered around."
The injured were taken to local hospitals, where several were being treated, Hughes said. One of the injured children was admitted for abdominal pains.
Witnesses told police that the truck "appeared to be out of control" just before it hit the restaurant, Hughes said.
Police said they had yet to determine whether the driver was intoxicated.
